verdict.rationale: MoonPay says it runs KYC for integrators through its hosted widget. Its headless SDK adds a co-branded connect/onboarding flow, an email-OTP auth frame, and a self-driving challenge frame that runs the required verification steps, for example guest-checkout limit upgrades, before a transaction proceeds. Onboarding is embedded and MoonPay-run rather than exposed as documented KYC/KYB endpoints the integrator drives, and it covers end customers buying or selling crypto, not business counterparties or payout recipients. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB API endpoints, business (KYB) verification, recipient/counterparty clearing, KYC-status webhooks or verification-status queries, independent corroboration.
